information: ## Davis' Summer competition makes a return! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1ODQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--755e0e2f757fb83f78f14bc546f1c91ad7bcd42a/bigsummer.png) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**. - If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and sponsored by [GAN Cube](https://www.gancube.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/)** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1MzQwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf1f2e001a5c557197f6e408d63692ab9adf34d6/image.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyOTQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dec59f56c8fb8ee9cf0ef018f518c05b695c930b/image.png)
